scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web "npm run dev -w @hireproof/shared" "npm run dev -w @hireproof/api" "npm run dev -w @hireproof/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @hireproof/api -w @hireproof/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
